title: QuestionAskedPayload
description:
Typed payload of [`AgentEvent::QuestionAsked`].

The event keeps `questions: serde_json::Value` on the wire for backward compatibility; this DTO is the canonical typed shape for consumers that validate or map the event (C10/T22).

question_id.description: Pending question batch id (also the `question.answer` correlation id).

questions.description: Questions in this batch (non-empty in practice).

QuestionDef.description:
One question the agent asks before continuing (`ask_user_question` tool input).

Mirrors the tool's argument schema: `id`/`question` are required; `header`, `options`, `multi_select` are optional and default to empty/false.

id.description: Stable question id (key in the answers map).

multi_select.description: Whether multiple options may be selected.

QuestionOption.description: One selectable option of a user question (`ask_user_question` tool input).

description.description: Optional secondary description shown under the label.
